A smile goes a long way
Jan 2025 • Couples
From the road, this place looks fantastic! We decided to call in for a drink on the way to our restaurant of choice for the evening. 

There were 5 staff working and all stood around chatting, smoking & drinking. 

The barman had to google how to make a cocktail. The vibe was uneasy and awkward. The drinks were basic and very expensive for Nha Trang. 

We had to ask to place a drink order and the first waitress grunted at us. The second then came along and took our order. No smiles, no friendly faces. 

If you are charging this sort of money for drinks the service, quality & vibe needs to be 5*!
